name: batch-tools
description: Hardened, zero-dependency batch search (ripgrep with Node fallback), multi-file symbol outlines and line slices, and atomic multi-file edits with strict workspace confinement and inline byte budgeting.
suggestedPrompts: Search across the workspace for all usages of a symbol and related config keys in one batch
Outline the main server modules and inspect the key handler line ranges
Preview an atomic multi-file refactor with dryRun before applying it
